meta.name: general-video
meta.description: The fallback workflow for authoring or editing any custom HyperFrames composition at any length or format — longer / multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, title cards, static loops, freeform builds. Use only when no specialized workflow fits the input; routing table at /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创作或编辑任意长度的自定义视频合成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作多场景视频、品牌短片或动态图形。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit custom video compositions of any length
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce multi-scene videos, brand reels, or motion graphics.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照你的要求创作或编辑自定义视频，包括多场景短片、品牌宣传片、标题卡等。它会先规划视觉风格和布局，再生成 HTML/CSS 动画。
howto.when: 当你提出视频创作或编辑请求，且没有更专门的技能匹配时触发。例如要求“做一个品牌宣传片”或“给这段视频加个标题卡”。

say.text: 帮我做一个30秒的产品宣传视频。
say.note: Claude 会先询问受众、平台等，然后生成视频。

say.text: 给这个视频加一个标题卡。
say.note: Claude 会直接添加标题卡，跳过规划步骤。

say.text: 把第三幕的时长调整到5秒。
say.note: Claude 会直接修改时长，不额外添加内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will create or edit custom video compositions based on your request, including multi-scene pieces, brand reels, title cards, etc. It plans visual identity and layout first, then generates HTML/CSS animations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request video creation or editing and no specialized workflow fits. For example, 'make a brand video' or 'add a title card to this video'.

say_en.note: Claude will ask about audience, platform, etc., then generate the video.

say_en.text: Add a title card to this video.
say_en.note: Claude will directly add the title card, skipping planning steps.

say_en.text: Adjust the duration of scene 3 to 5 seconds.
say_en.note: Claude will directly modify the duration without adding extra elements.
